blurb:
Step onto the mesmerizing blue ice of Matanuska Glacier with this exhilarating 8-hour hiking adventure. Departing daily from Anchorage, this guided experience includes professional safety gear and expert instruction, ensuring that you navigate the glacier safely and comfortably. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Matanuska Valley while keeping an eye out for local wildlife as you trek through this stunning wilderness. Capture your journey with free digital photos, creating lasting memories of this unique Alaskan experience.

- 8-hour guided glacier hiking adventure in Matanuska Valley
- Professional safety gear provided for a secure hiking experience
- Free digital photos included to remember your adventure
- Suitable for all skill levels, including seniors and families
